'''Chrethbac''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tarasin]] [[Force Adept]], who served as an ally to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Chrethbac was being considered for admission into the [[Almas Academy]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] academy of [[Almas]], so he accompanied a group of Jedi, led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kirlocca]], on an expedition into the [[Almas Wasteland]]. However, Chrethbac and some of the other Jedi fell under the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and attacked their companions. A group of agents sent by Master [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] found him and he attacked them, because the dark side tricked him into thinking that they were [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and wanted to destroy him. However, they were able to subdue him, without killing him.<ref name="DC" />
